name: duplimend_optimized_v1
description: The exact DupliMend configuration used for every result reported in the paper.
derived_from: median (numeric) / mode (categorical) across the 4 group-level Bayesian-optimization winners

provenance.note: Seed 42 was used ONLY for the hyperparameter search. The reported results are ten independent evaluation runs with seeds 1-10; see seeds.json.

derived_values._hidden_dims_rule: hidden_dims = [2 * layer_size, layer_size] for n_hidden_layers = 2; the encoder is [256, 128] -> latent 64 and the decoder mirrors it.

env_var_mapping._comment: config/config.py reads every parameter from these environment variables at import time. config/paper_config.py emits exactly this mapping.

discovery_params._source: Stated in the paper: models are discovered with the Inductive Miner at a noise threshold of 0.2, imported via PM4Py.
metrics_reported: F-score (harmonic mean of Precision and Fitness)
discovery_params.checkpoint: Results are reported at the final 100% checkpoint.

differs_from_repo_defaults._comment: The committed defaults in config/config.py are development defaults. Each entry is [repo_default, paper_value].

warmup_note: warmup_proportion = 0.20 means the warm-up phase consumes the first 20% of a log's events. config/config.py takes an absolute event count via WARMUP_EVENTS. Per-log warm-up values are recorded in log_manifest.json.
